# Scope menu icon exceptions to their platform selectors and markup consumers

Fresh complete seven-file430-line public source follow-up read. Calendar/browser/address-book menu markup gains no-icon-menupopup; macOS and Linux icon/gutter rules and a calendar task pseudo-icon rule change; shared popup minimum width becomes12ch. Current selected markup retains the class. Current shared CSS uses logical min-inline-size12ch, hides matching menu/menuitem icons and separately restores extension root icons. Imported toolkit implementation and native rendering were not inspected. The historical macOS selector excludes needsgutter and no-icon-menupopup; fixed accepted source additionally excludes textbox-contextmenu. This later exception must not be attributed to this exact landing. Fixed Linux rules also contain later visibility/checked handling beyond the removed blanket hide rule. No new tests. No native menu, visual, accessibility, build, lint or test execution; numbered Bug gaps keep zero audit credit. Exact unavailable discussion keeps this public source-only knowledge at zero full-audit credit. No runtime or test ran.

Scope: Platform menu icon/gutter and markup scope.
